items.title: Christopher "Happy" Goldston Interview, 1962-04-11
items.q: Well, who was in the Tulane band besides you and Son and Riley? Oh, Winnie Skelly.

ctx.x: Well, who was in the Tulane band besides you and Son and Riley?
The trombone, huh? The trombone man. And, oh, it's been so long, I'd... Did they use saxophones then, or did they? No, no, they used saxophones. They just climbed that down.
